name: Pope Julius II
role: Head of the Catholic Church from 1503 to 1513
contribution: Head of the Catholic Church and leader of the Papal States from 1503 to his death, in February 1513.

checks.lead: Pope Julius II (Latin: Iulius II; Italian: Giulio II; born Giuliano della Rovere; 5 December 1443 – 21 February 1513) was head of the Catholic Church and leader of the Papal States from 1503 to his death, in February 1513.
